settings.title: Settings
settings.workspaceSubtitle: Configure project and skill storage locations
settings.workspaceRootHelp: All projects will be cloned or linked under this directory.
settings.skillRepoPathHelp: Centralized skill repository location; the app reads available skills from here.
settings.updateGuide: First launch may be blocked by Gatekeeper. If so, open System Settings > Privacy & Security to approve the app, then launch it from /Applications.
settings.channelSubtitle: Long-connection message receiving and delivery: receive links to trigger capture, deliver digest and failure notifications
settings.channelHelp: Use Feishu WebSocket long-connection mode; no public IP or callback domain needed. The robot triggers the link-capture flow on receiving an http(s) link, and delivers digests after daily runs.

agent.identityHelp: Name, tone or extra instructions (up to {{max}} characters). Leave empty to use only the built-in identity.
agent.bindingGuide: Open Feishu and send a message to the bot to complete binding

credentialsModule.title: Service Credentials
credentialsModule.subtitle: Securely manage external service endpoints and access keys, encrypted with system keychain
credentialsModule.rsshubDesc: Configure RSSHub base URL and optional AccessKey to automatically convert X/Twitter, Bilibili, and WeChat into structured feeds.
credentialsModule.accessKeyPlaceholder: Encrypted and stored; enter to replace (optional)
credentialsModule.rsshubTipContent: Platforms like Bilibili and X/Twitter have strict anti-crawler mechanisms. When running a self-hosted RSSHub instance, please configure corresponding environment variables (e.g. BILIBILI_COOKIE, TWITTER_COOKIE) in your deployment to avoid rate-limiting or timeouts.

sources.title: Sources
sources.subtitle: Register sources for agent collection; flows reference enabled sources by tag.
sources.name: Name
sources.empty: No content sources yet. Click "New Source" to register your first source.
sources.nameError: Name is required and must not exceed 64 characters
sources.tagPlaceholder: Enter tag and press Enter (e.g. AI)
sources.tagTooLong: Each tag must not exceed 16 characters
sources.tagsRequired: Please add at least one category tag
sources.tagsHelp: At least 1. Flows reference sources by tag (e.g. all enabled sources with tag=AI), not one by one.
sources.xWechatDisclaimer: x / wechat / bilibili sources rely on configured RSSHub instance for route resolution
sources.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete content source "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone; flows referencing this source by tag will naturally skip it on next run.

typeHelp.webpage: Fetch the page body and convert it to Markdown.
typeHelp.rss: Subscribe to the latest entries from the RSS / Atom feed.
typeHelp.bilibili: Enter the numeric UID of the uploader. Tip: Bilibili anti-crawler is strict; self-hosted RSSHub needs BILIBILI_COOKIE configured in environment.
typeHelp.x: Enter the username (e.g. @elonmusk). Tip: Self-hosted RSSHub requires Twitter credentials/Cookies and network proxy.
typeHelp.wechat: Enter the official account ID to auto-convert to an RSS feed via RSSHub.

troubleshooting.bilibili: Bilibili enforces strict WBI anti-crawler checks on server IPs. If requests time out, please configure BILIBILI_COOKIE (with SESSDATA and bili_jct) in your RSSHub docker-compose/.env environment.
troubleshooting.x: If X/Twitter requests time out, please check your RSSHub proxy connectivity or configure Twitter authorization cookies.
troubleshooting.general: If connection times out, please inspect your RSSHub server logs to verify connectivity with upstream platforms.
